mistake.headline:
Both feet. Big jump.
Pause on every landing.
mistake.body: You end up jumping over the rope instead of letting it pass under you. More pounding on your knees, less speed, and you gas out fast.

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan skipping rope one foot at a time with a high knee

fix.headline:
Skip it like
a boxer.
fix.body: One foot at a time, low and quick, like you're running in place. In this clip I'm at about [em]155 steps a minute.[/em]

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan skipping rope, knee raised, light on the balls of his feet

cues.title: 3 cues
cues.subtitle: for the boxer skip
items: Feet an inch off the ground. Not a foot.
Turn the rope with your wrists, not your shoulders.
Stay on the balls of your feet. Heels never touch down.

blocks.title: Send it
blocks.text: to the guy at your gym who jumps like a kangaroo.

cta.follow: One fix a week, filmed on me.
